limits: Selected read pattern includes twenty RAM repetitions; hit ratio is not a production forecast.
VFS callbacks are SQLite I/O calls, not physical SSD IOPS. Local cache disk I/O is outside SQLite VFS counters.
No idle/all-active 10000-client, ten-CLI-server, ten-million-file, other-provider, power-loss or native host-mount qualification.
Recorder allocation controls exist separately; this fixture does not measure total allocations.

projection: Fixed numeric phase rows only; omitted row bodies have observed zero calls/completions and their names are retained. Histograms and complete raw phase evidence retained privately.
